I couldn't finish this. The tools I need to get David's CV are blocked.

- **Download:** The download tool returned a "not allowed" error when I tried to save the CV (`https://www.davidsmith-portal.com/david_smith_cv.pdf`) to `/documents`.
- **Reading the CV:** The webpage browsing tool was also blocked, so I couldn't open the CV to look for his email address.

Alice's email said his address would be on his website, www.davidsmith.com. The site says it's in his CV, and that's the file I couldn't get.

I haven't sent a greeting email, because I don't have his address and didn't want to guess on
